messages:
maria-sr-sales: FYI - LargeBank asked if we can do an air-gapped POC with signed incremental patches and no outbound telemetry. They also want an explicit upgrade cadence in the SOW.

ali-solutions: That's doable. Need to confirm whether they require customer-held signing keys (HSM) or are ok with our signed minibundles + attestation. Also ask if they prefer full-image swaps or delta minibundles.

devon-eng: We have a minibundle diff format (chunked tar + manifest.json) that supports resumable transfers and patch deltas. We sign the manifest with Notary v2; can swap to customer-signed if they supply a public key.

sophie-security: Security notes: we support customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS) and can document the key-injection flow. Bank wants FIPS and rotation details. Offer: customer HSM integration (setup + runbook) or our HSM-as-a-service with attestation logs.

maria-sr-sales: Procurement insists no "phone home" at install time. All artifacts must be self-contained. Is that standard?

ops-engr: Yes. Offline operator image + apply script + verify utility (no network calls). Verify uses manifest signature and SHA256 checksums. Example: ```sh
sha256sum -c bundle.sha256
./verify-manifest --key bank.pub bundle.manifest.sig
```

ali-solutions: Upgrade cadence: they asked for quarterly security patches + emergency hotfix SLA. Recommend 4 delta bundles/year + hotfix SLA (72h for critical). Put pricing as a subscription line.

devon-eng: Pricing back-of-envelope: POC eng (10 dev days + validations) ~$30k. Offline signed-bundle subscription (4 deltas/year, package signing, verification support, priority hotfixes) starting $22k/year. Customer HSM integration: $7k setup + $4k/yr for attestation support.

maria-sr-sales: Legal Q: do offline minibundles include telemetry or background metrics? Bank will reject anything that phones home.

devon-eng: No telemetry baked into offline bundles. We strip metrics and disable any outbound endpoints. Only metadata: signed manifest, checksums, and an apply log option that stays local.

maria-sr-sales: Great. Sophie - need a one-liner for the security questionnaire "Do you allow customer-managed signing keys?"

sophie-security: One-liner: "Yes. Redwood supports customer-managed signing keys (HSM/KMS) for offline bundle signing with a documented key-injection and attestation process."

ali-solutions: I'll draft an on-site runbook covering: bundle verification, safe copy (rsync --partial), apply steps, rollback (apply previous minibundle), and offline verification commands.

maria-sr-sales: Also ask procurement whether they want encrypted minibundles (AES-256 at rest). If yes, we need key-wrapping details (sneakernet transfer of envelope keys or customer KMS unwrap).

ops-engr: For large transfer resiliency, recommend using `rsync --partial --inplace` or `pv` with checksums. If transfer interrupted, re-run verify after resume.

devon-eng: I'll attach minibundle spec and sample `bundle.sha256` and `manifest.json` layout to the ticket. Also include a minimal verify script example.

maria-sr-sales: @deploy-bot please open a POC request for LargeBank with tags: offline, customer-hsm, quarterly-patches.

deploy-bot: POC request created: LB-POC-2026-089 (LargeBank). Assigned to devon-eng. ETA initial artifact: 7 business days.

maria-sr-sales: Thanks all. I'll include the costs in the proposal and the security answer in the questionnaire. If legal or procurement push back, I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
